problem: The same 48 queries recovered 0/7 gold-document cases at full-document BM25 top-20, 2/7 at passage BM25 top-20, 0/7 at dense top-20, and only 1/7 at dense top-100. Reopening candidate depth, reranking, or unconstrained query generation would violate the registered stopping rules.
simplest_baseline: Reuse the identical successful trial-1 queries without a pivot; the frozen full-document BM25 top-20 result is 0/7.
hypothesis: At least four of seven persistent misses have one analyzed term that was literally exposed in a saved non-gold result snippet, also occurs in an indexed gold document, is absent from the question, generated queries, and gold answer, and brings a gold document into BM25 top-20 when appended to one frozen query.
changed_mechanisms: one gold-aware visible-pivot token appended to a frozen generated query
anti_claim: The pivot is selected with gold-document knowledge for sufficiency diagnosis only; this is not a deployable selector, end-to-end improvement, or model-capability improvement.

framework_comparisons.current_gap: Before assigning another worker, test whether the current single context already saw a reusable bridge token and simply failed to turn it into the next search constraint.
Changing the backend is larger than the remaining causal question; this oracle keeps the index and scorer fixed while testing one evidence-derived query transition.
A broader crawl adds calls before proving that saved snippets already contain a sufficient pivot for one bounded follow-up query.
A visible-pivot hop is the smallest testable edge of a search graph; only a positive oracle would justify implementing a gold-blind edge selector before parallel graph expansion.

frozen_controls: same seven outcome-selected persistent retrieval misses
same trial-1 set and order of 48 successful generated queries
same saved successful search-result snippets as the only visible pivot source
same 100,195-document full-document BM25 index with k1 0.9 and b 0.4
pivot must occur in a visible non-gold snippet and a gold document
raw-question, generated-query, and gold-answer analyzed terms excluded
maximum 64 pivots per case ordered by document frequency then term
one pivot token appended to one frozen query and top-k fixed at 20
zero provider, online search, and Judge calls
next_action: Commit this registration before implementation, then build a deterministic offline oracle that verifies saved-snippet provenance, exclusion vocabularies, index hashes, baseline 0/7 reproduction, the 3,120-query cap, and the fixed 4/7 decision without provider, online search, Judge, GPU, or sealed-holdout access.
claim_boundary: A pass is only evidence that a one-hop visible lexical bridge exists on these observed failures. It cannot support an effectiveness claim until a separate gold-blind selector passes a frozen unseen development comparison.
